issue_context.title: Svelte 5: select value doesn't match bound value after removing option
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

When options are rendered from an array via an `#each` loop, and the selected item is removed from the array, no option should be selected since none match the bound value. This works as expected in Svelte 4, but in Svelte 5 an option that doesn't match the bound value incorrectly appears selected.

### Reproduction

[Svelte 5 REPL](https://svelte-5-preview.vercel.app/#H4sIAAAAAAAAClVRy26EMAz8FTe9gLQqdxqQKu0XtMfNHngYNRIkaeIgVZR_bx7QVU9OZuzxTLKxSc7oWH3bmOoWZDV7M4ZdGH2beHErzoTh7rS3Q0S4G6w01AolaEYCSbg4aOAmWCfYBQTrcxkEu7-eXQ5nHAjHCARo8mogqRWMASf8ONiihC3Sgk7VVF-CR0JbFLKEpgUJT03zp1imHbtQvHo4U3zSdgGtauf7RdKPsbiioitOnZ-p2f7v3VManiWhl2qs12722Gznlh0sfnlpcWyzwe0Zu-HzSN-5dNgzFZS0SekOkcS1ufAqc6dMFWXSYPCflrX5iXjviULfOy56RchTvDrQGDdGzGFNeyap4WGZVybQ4e8WPcpJ4shqsh73-_4LNknWfvYBAAA=)

[Svelte 4 REPL](https://svelte.dev/repl/491353c2882941199ef2678a18fd593d?version=4.2.7) for comparison.

I implemented [a test which fails in Svelte 5](https://github.com/theodorejb/svelte/commit/a4b14a1513a437f120b0bd2402cd316e3805177a) while passing in Svelte 4.

### Logs

_No response_

### System Info

```shell
Firefox, Edge
```


### Severity

blocking an upgrade
comments: I'm unsure what the correct behavior should be here. Should the selected option be updated, or should it be out of sync?

I would suggest making it behave like v4 for compatibility.

It can just be the responsibility of whoever removes the option to also update the selection/value if necessary/desired.

I agree the behavior should match Svelte 4. I got stuck trying to implement this myself, though, as I'm not sure how to detect that the selected option was removed from the DOM, or else run `select_option` as an effect after options have been replaced.
Probably the most robust way is using a mutationobserver to check the list for changes
